events.description: As of late August 2001, indications that an individual associated with al-Qa'ida was considering mounting terrorist operations in the United States. No further information was available on timing, attacks, or targets.

As of late August 2001 there were indications that an individual associated with al-Qa'ida was considering mounting terrorist operations in the United States. No further information was available on the timing of attacks or the alleged targets.
The CIA issued a sanitized version of a threat report on terrorism to White House, State, military and other agency recipients. Per the document header, it was approved for release on 25 April 2012.

relationships.detail: An individual associated with al-Qa'ida was reportedly considering mounting terrorist operations in the United States (a targeting relationship).
relationships.quote: AN INDIVIDUAL ASSOCIATED WITH AL-QA'IDA WAS CONSIDERING MOUNTING TERRORIST OPERATIONS IN THE UNITED STATES.

sources_cited: CIA information report (sanitized version of threat report), approved for release 25 April 2012
key_claims: As of late August 2001 there were indications that an individual associated with al-Qa'ida was considering mounting terrorist operations in the United States.
No further information was available on the timing of any attacks or on the alleged targets in the United States.
